records.question: Q4296
records.type: all-dimension theorem using established external PFR
records.statement: Every admissible k-colour midpoint partition of F_3^n with remainder density at least 1/10 has an affine subspace in R of codimension O(k log(2k)).
records.extension: Over each fixed odd prime p, density alpha>0 gives codimension O_p(k(log(2k)+log(1/alpha))).
records.source_comparison: Theorem 3 of arXiv:2610.11847v1 gives O(k^2) at p=3 and alpha=1/10.
records.remaining: The exact extremal function and removal of the logarithmic factor are not determined.

records.question: Q4296
records.statement: If A is covered by M cosets of H, s <= dim(W/H), and M p^(-s)<1, then an affine codimension-s subspace avoiding A exists on which any nonnegative function has average at most its ambient average divided by 1-M p^(-s).
records.scope: No small-doubling or midpoint hypothesis is required for this standalone lemma.

records.question: Q4296
records.statement: For n>=kb, the remainder with every one of k disjoint b-dimensional blocks nonzero admits k midpoint colours on its complement and has largest affine subspace dimension exactly n-k; density is (1-p^(-b))^k.
records.priority_note: The primary source already notes linear-loss constructions; no priority claim for necessity of linear loss.

records.question: Q4660
records.consequence: The least universal entropy sum-difference constant is strictly greater than 70259/50000 = 1.40518.
records.high_entropy_extension: Independent digit copies encoded in base 16 preserve the ratio and have arbitrarily large entropy.
records.remaining: No proof of the sharp universal constant, no global optimizer, and no improvement to Q4659.
